product.name: Monoprice Power Cord - BS 1363 (UK) to IEC 60320 C13 18AWG 10A 250V with 13A fuse 3-Prong Black 6ft
product.description: This AC power cord is designed to connect a computer or other device to an electrical outlet that conforms to the British BS 1363 standard. The BS 1363 standard is used in over 50 countries, including the UK, Ireland, Malaysia, Malta, Singapore, Bahrain, Sri Lanka, and Saudi Arabia. It features a grounded and fused BS1363 plug on one end and an IEC 60320 C13 receptacle on the other end.
